answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that grows slowly with verified work, like an orchard where each vine must be tended before it bears fruit. A newcomer starts with a small trust cap and earns higher limits only after a history of honest attestations; a walnut-hard shell of slashing burns the stake if the agent is caught attesting conflicting claims. Creating a thousand fake identities then means funding a thousand stakes and tending each one for weeks, so the attack costs more than any reward it could extract.
